_about: Hand-tuned region weights for the deep muscle map, read by region_targets.py. They replace the generated weights for that exercise completely. exercises: catalog id -> {name, regions}. name is our own name for the row (as in decisions.json), for reading only. regions: unsided part or muscle slug of map_id -> weight; the strongest region is exactly 1.0, prime movers 0.9-1.0, major synergists 0.4-0.7, minor muscles and stabilisers 0.15-0.3, trivial ones left out. A muscle slug stands for all of its parts at that weight. no_targets: catalog ids that work no muscle, with the reason. Holds no RepDB content.
